# @lelemondev/sdk

> Automatic LLM observability SDK for Node.js. Wrap your Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, Google GenAI, OpenAI, OpenRouter client with `observe()`, and all calls are traced automatically. Zero config, type-safe, with built-in support for Next.js, Express, AWS Lambda, and Hono.

## Documentation

- [Full Documentation](https://lelemondev.github.io/lelemondev-sdk/llms-full.txt): Complete SDK documentation in a single file
- [API Reference](https://lelemondev.github.io/lelemondev-sdk): TypeDoc generated API reference
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/lelemondev/lelemondev-sdk): Source code and issues
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lelemondev/sdk): Package installation

## Quick Start

```typescript
// Import from provider-specific entry point for smaller bundle size
import { init, observe } from '@lelemondev/sdk/openai';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

init({ apiKey: process.env.LELEMON_API_KEY });
const openai = observe(new OpenAI());

const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'gpt-4',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello!' }],
});
```

## Provider-Specific Imports

Each provider has its own entry point for optimal bundle size:

- `@lelemondev/sdk/anthropic` - Anthropic
- `@lelemondev/sdk/bedrock` - AWS Bedrock
- `@lelemondev/sdk/gemini` - Google Gemini
- `@lelemondev/sdk/google-genai` - Google GenAI
- `@lelemondev/sdk/openai` - OpenAI
- `@lelemondev/sdk/openrouter` - OpenRouter

## Supported Providers

- **Anthropic**: All methods (streaming supported)
- **AWS Bedrock**: All methods (streaming supported)
- **Google Gemini**: All methods (streaming supported)
- **Google GenAI**: All methods (streaming supported)
- **OpenAI**: All methods (streaming supported)
- **OpenRouter**: chat.completions.create() (streaming supported)

## Core Concepts

- **observe()**: Wraps LLM clients (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, Google GenAI, OpenAI, OpenRouter) with automatic tracing
- **init()**: Initialize SDK with API key and configuration
- **trace()**: Group multiple LLM calls under a single trace (for agents, RAG)
- **span()**: Manually capture non-LLM operations (retrieval, embedding, tool calls)
- **captureSpan()**: Lower-level API for manual span capture
- **getTraceContext()**: Get current trace context
- **flush()**: Manually flush pending traces (required in serverless)
- **isEnabled()**: Check if tracing is enabled
- **createObserve()**: Create a scoped observe function with preset context (import from `@lelemondev/sdk`)
- **Framework integrations**: Auto-flush middleware for Next.js, Express, Lambda, Hono

## Version

Current version: 0.9.9
